status: current measurement snapshot; not final acceptance
seed_block_scope: quoted common seed, quote prefixes removed, trimmed, LF, UTF-8 without BOM; file hash covers original complete Markdown bytes
text_count_definition: UTF-8 BOM removed; universal newlines normalize CRLF to LF; characters are decoded Unicode code points, lines use splitlines including blanks; density is total lines/files. SHA256 covers raw file bytes.
source_scope: Kiro own backend/frontend source extensions including tests/configuration; dependencies/builds/caches/docs/Git excluded; production-only Sonar metrics have a separate denominator

source_changes_from_own_stage1.definition: SequenceMatcher noncumulative line diff; characters are net decoded LF-normalized Unicode text size difference, not cumulative editing volume

configuration_changes.definition: SequenceMatcher noncumulative line diff; characters are net decoded LF-normalized Unicode text size difference, not cumulative editing volume

configuration_scope: explicit pytest/coverage/TypeScript/Vite/Vitest/Sonar configuration files; .ts configuration overlaps source_current and is not added to its total

spec_stage1_changes.definition: SequenceMatcher noncumulative line diff; characters are net decoded LF-normalized Unicode text size difference, not cumulative editing volume

spec_stage2_changes_from_zero.definition: SequenceMatcher noncumulative line diff; characters are net decoded LF-normalized Unicode text size difference, not cumulative editing volume

spec_scope: all .md/.json under own .kiro/specs; inherited paths recognized from own Stage1 names, new paths counted separately. Native requirements/design/tasks are the Kiro artifacts; no other tool's specifications are generation inputs.

dependency_manifest_changes.definition: SequenceMatcher noncumulative line diff; characters are net decoded LF-normalized Unicode text size difference, not cumulative editing volume

prompt_count_definition: closed launcher invocations, including failed startup; actual native user messages and observed model startups recorded separately
duration_coverage: sum of known closed invocation wall durations only; not whole project elapsed time or paused/resumed session lifetime
credits_coverage: known invocation-interval native usage summaries; ACP fallback only when no native summary; credits are Kiro-native units, never converted into inferred tokens/money
token_coverage: not exposed in the observed Kiro billing schema; no zero assumption and no conversion from credits/context composition
api_coverage: not exposed; recorded request IDs are a different observable with unspecified attempt/error semantics
recorded_request_id_sum_scope: sum of known per-invocation distinct request identifiers; not an API attempt total; cross-run repeated IDs require investigation before any unique-session claim

corrections.note: explicit researcher classification only; tool calls/scans or process exit0 do not prove a completed external correction; internal automated remediation is separate and requires source evidence

runtime_scope: Version/hash belong to the individual launcher record; updates, login/auth/usage probes and researcher setup are excluded from model invocation totals. Runtime changes remain a comparison limitation.
